lines.en: label halloween1:
scene firsthalloweenevent1
I’m relaxing in my room after a long and uneventful day at[school].
Well, maybe not entirely uneventful.
Molly took it upon herself to start hosting some impromptu game show since nothing else was going on.
It pretty much ruined any chance I had of sleeping through the post-lunch part of the day so, believe it or not, I’m in a pretty sour mood right now.
Now, I know what you’re thinking-
That I’m typically so full of life and am essentially the beacon of what a self-sufficient adult male should be.
But I assure you-
Right now, there isn’t anything that could possibly make me feel any better.
: Hi! Coming in now!
scene firsthalloweenevent2
: Good evening, Sensei. How would you like to see all of us in costumes?
Never mind. Life is good again.
: Yes, please.
: You’re supposed to wait until after someone responds to the knock to actually go into their room, Ayane.
: Why doesn’t anyone understand the concept of knocking around here?
: Ami, don’t you do that exact thing with my office at work all the time?
scene firsthalloweenevent3
: I have special [niece] privileges! I don’t need to wait for you to answer since I have to make sure you’re okay!
: Why would I be in distress in my own office?
: Because I said so!
: Umm...I don’t really think I should...be in here...
: It feels a little...early...
scene firsthalloweenevent4
: Oh, stop. You’re in good hands.
: Besides, if Sensei tries to do anything lewd to you, I’ll just sacrifice myself in your place so you can continue being pure.
: Umm...
: Thank...you?...
: Sorry to interrupt, but I’m going to need a little more information about you three putting on costumes for me.
: Since you’re all in my room, I can only assume it's because you want to-
scene firsthalloweenevent5
: Halloween party. Ayane’s house. Shopping. Go. Tomorrow.
: Ayane, translate.
: What she said pretty much covers all of the bases.
: Sunday is Halloween, and Geoffrey said it’s okay if we throw a party at my place.
: I already know what I’m going as, but Ami and Sana still need to buy a few things to get their costumes ready.
: I...don’t even know what I want to be yet...
: So if you have any ideas...
A Halloween costume for Sana?
She'd look cute in pretty much anything, so I might as well use this opportunity to put an idea I like quite a bit in her head.
: Why not some sort of animal? Like...a cat or something?
I'd also accept a rabbit. Or a dog.
Actually, I’m sure she’ll be adorable in whatever she chooses.
I stand by my initial cat-choice, though. Cat-girl Sana is my number-one pick.
scene firsthalloweenevent6
: Oooooh! I want to see you dressed up like an animal too!
: And then I want to take pictures of you in the dorm and keep them in a special photo-album that I can look at whenever I feel sad!
: Let’s do it!
: Ayane...You’re scaring me again...
scene firsthalloweenevent7
: Wait, does this whole ‘taking you guys shopping’ thing mean I’m going to be spending money? Or is Ayane fronting everything?
: Oh, I can’t pay for Ami this time.
: I actually got into trouble for spending a little over my monthly allowance on the beach trip, so I can’t really buy an extra costume or anything.
: Is that a problem?
: I have some money saved up that I could probably use, but I was hoping to spend that on something a little different.
: How about you just...go in your pajamas? You can be a...tired girl for Halloween.
scene firsthalloweenevent8
: That’s a horrible idea, even for you.
: I don’t want to walk around Ayane’s mansion in my pajamas.
: You walk around our house in your pajamas all the time.
scene firsthalloweenevent9
: I’m not walking around a mansion in my pajamas! That is final!
: Come to think of it, this will be your first time actually coming over...won't it, Sensei?
: Does this mean it’s finally time for you to meet my dad and tell him that we’ll be getting married?
scene firsthalloweenevent10
: Does this mean I’ll have to explain to him what happened when the police discover both of your bodies chopped up and placed into dumpsters all around the city?
: Oh, right. I told you I’d hold off on hitting on your [uncle] while you’re around. Sorry.
scene firsthalloweenevent11
: Not just ‘while I’m around!’ In general! Stop hitting on my [uncle]!
scene firsthalloweenevent12
: Umm...Sensei?...
: Have these two always...fought like this?
: You’ve known them both for a long time and...it’s a little strange to me how much they yell when they’re...supposedly best friends.
That’s a good question. I wonder how long this rivalry goes back?
I’m sure it got worse after Ayane and I started having a more...sexual relationship, but I’m pretty sure they’ve had to always kind of be like this, right?
: I stopped keeping track, to be honest. I’ve just accepted it as a part of life.
scene firsthalloweenevent13
: Hey, that’s exactly what I’ve done with my love for you!
: I realized there’s no good way to hide it, so I’ve just added that trait into my personality.
: Didn’t you literally just tell Ami you’d stop doing this?
: Oh, right.
: This is exactly what I’m talking about, though. I can’t help it.
: Why are you still here?!
scene firsthalloweenevent14
: The same reason you’re here, Ami.
: Because it’ll be getting dark out any minute now and we’re all going to sleep in Sensei’s bed with him tonight.
: I’m sorry, what?
: I’m sorry, what?...
: Isn’t this the perfect opportunity? I obviously wouldn’t have barged in here just to tell him about a party. I could have texted him that.
: So you barged in here to sleep in his bed?...
: This is...a joke...right?
: No one is laughing, so I...don’t really know...
: In case anyone wants my opinion, I’m fine with Ayane's idea.
scene firsthalloweenevent15
: Yay! Slumber party!
: Of course you’re okay with it! You’re a stupid boy!
: I’m...not okay with it! I don’t even like sleeping with Ayane!
scene firsthalloweenevent16
: Oh? Then how come you always squeeze my arm in the middle of the night, Sana?
: Excuse me, but I’d like to inquire about why you two sleep together when you have separate beds.
: I’d also like a little more detail about how Sana looks while she is squeezing you and the noises she makes while she sleeps.
scene firsthalloweenevent17
: S-Sensei!
: I’m glad you asked, future-husband!
: She makes these cute little moaning noises whenever she rolls over that make my heart skip a beat even though I don’t like girls.
: They’ve even made me question my love for you on several occasions, Sensei.
: You always come out on top, though, so don't worry! I’m sorry for the confusing thoughts about my roommate!
scene firsthalloweenevent18
: What confusing thoughts?! This is the first time I’ve heard about any confusing thoughts!
: I don’t like how your eyes look right now, Sensei...
: How do they look, exactly?
: They’re filled with desire. Like you’re thinking things you shouldn’t be thinking.
: Look at me. Only me. Not Ayane or Sana.
: In fact, tell those two to get out of here and I will sleep in your bed tonight. To protect you, of course.
scene firsthalloweenevent19
: But Sensei doesn’t need protection. Isn’t that right, Sensei?
: Excuse me?
: Protection is for cowards. I know how to take care of myself.
: You also know how to take care of-
: One more word and you die.
: ...Flowers!
: You are an admirable gardener.
scene firsthalloweenevent20
: Umm...are we planning on staying here much longer?
: I told my mom I could work tonight and...I didn’t realize you had planned a sleepover here...
: I really wish you’d tell me these things in advance...
: Also...I’d...really appreciate it if...you don’t take me into boys’ rooms anymore.
: It smells like Sensei in here and it makes me feel funny.
: Right? It's magical, isn't it?
: Doesn’t it get your heart racing, Sana?
: Being just inches away from where Sensei sleeps? Where he dreams?
: Can’t you feel your blood pumping?!
scene firsthalloweenevent21
: No?
scene firsthalloweenevent22
: Well, either way, be prepared to take us shopping tomorrow, Sensei.
: Like I said, I don’t need anything, but it’s not like I’m going to just turn down an opportunity to spend more time with you. Hahahahaha!
scene firsthalloweenevent23
: Since Ayane doesn’t need anything, it would probably make more sense for just Sana and me to come, right?
: We can have her stay at home with her butler.
: Or, better yet, how about Sana doesn’t come either and the two of us spend the entire day together?
: Oh! And even better than that! How about the two of us just have our own Halloween party and let everyone else go to Ayane’s?
: That’s fine...but...I still need to find a costume...
: Don’t worry Sana, you’re still coming. And so is Ayane.
: Ami is old enough that I think it's time she learns the value of sharing.
: What am I sharing exactly? Because it certainly isn’t you.
: It is me.
scene firsthalloweenevent24
: I refuse.
: Love me more~
: I love you plenty enough already.
: Heheh~ Sensei said he loves me.
: Me next! Me next! Tell me you love me too!
: It’s not fair that only Ami gets to hear it when I’m the one who brought everyone in here!
: Reward me with your affection!
: ...I love you Ayane.
It really makes my stomach hurt having to use the ‘L’ word twice in one day, but I might as well try and go three-for-three while I’m at it.
scene firsthalloweenevent25
: Sana.
: I love you too.
scene firsthalloweenevent26
: Ah! Sana!
: Sensei! What do you think you’re doing?!
: I was just giving her the same treatment I gave you two.
: Is she dead?
: No! Just...unconscious, I think!
: Sana isn’t ready to accept your love yet! That comes much later in the story!
: How much later? I feel like I’ve been waiting for eons.
: Eons longer! Can’t you see how she’s reacting to just hearing your words?!
: I wish she’d react more like Ami. She’s handling it very well.
: Hehehe~ Love love love~ My [uncle] loves me~ Ayane is stupid~
scene firsthalloweenevent27
: Well...I guess there’s no harm in letting her nap on your floor for a little while.
: Didn’t she say she had work, though?
: Did she? I have an admittedly hard time focusing on anything that isn’t you while I’m in your room.
: Or in general, for that matter.
: Yeah, I’ve noticed that.
: What should we do about Ami, though? It seems like she’s under a spell right now.
: Oh, don’t worry about that. I know how to handle this.
scene firsthalloweenevent28
: Psst...Ami...
: *Unintelligible whispering noises*
: *Even more unintelligible whispering noises*
: Ayane, what are you-
scene firsthalloweenevent29
: Ah-
: Heheh~
: Is that really true?
scene firsthalloweenevent30
: Sensei...
: Ayane, what did you say to her?
: A secret, obviously. Why would I have whispered if it was something it was okay for you to hear?
: But...my curiosity...
: You have no idea...how happy it makes me to hear that...
: Hear what? What the hell did she say to you?
: Just a little of this and that. It’s nothing bad. Don’t worry.
: Ayane.
: Sensei~
scene firsthalloweenevent31
: Okay, Sana! Time to get up.
Ayane kneels down and begins to try and shake Sana back to consciousness.
Within a matter of minutes, she starts to come-to. While Ami, on the other hand...
Ami remains broken for the rest of the night.
scene black
